scripts.dev: npm run build -w @uefa-ranking/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @uefa-ranking/contracts && npm run build -w @uefa-ranking/backend && npm run build -w @uefa-ranking/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @uefa-ranking/contracts && npm run test -w @uefa-ranking/backend && npm run test -w @uefa-ranking/frontend
